description: Get a summary of snow conditions across an entire region or country with statistics and top resorts.

inputSchema.description: Provide region or country (at least one). Region is preferred for multi-country areas.

country.description: Exact country name when region is too broad, e.g. "Switzerland" or "Japan".

region.description: Geographic region to summarize, e.g. alps or japan.

name: get_regional_summary

markdown.description: Human-readable markdown summary of the tool result (may be omitted when structuredContent carries a typed payload; content[0].text always has the prose).

title: Regional snow summary
